_signatureNote: TODO(phase1): catalog is unsigned in the demo build. Phase 1 signs this file and the broker verifies the signature before loading any capability. See verifyCatalogSignature() in in-process-broker.js.

capabilities.title: Restart a Windows service
capabilities.description: Stops and restarts a single Windows background service. Reversible by restarting it again.

serviceName.description: Service to restart. Closed enum - no model-supplied string ever reaches the Service Control Manager.

capabilities.title: Flush the DNS resolver cache
capabilities.description: Clears cached DNS lookups so name resolution is retried fresh. Idempotent - no rollback needed.

capabilities.title: Release and renew the DHCP lease
capabilities.description: Asks the network's DHCP server for a fresh IP address. Brief loss of connectivity while renewing.

adapterIndex.description: Index from the local adapter enumeration. Resolved by the broker, not supplied freeform by the model.

capabilities.title: Disable and re-enable a network adapter
capabilities.description: Turns the network adapter off and back on. This WILL drop every network connection on this machine for a few seconds, including any remote session.

adapterId.description: Adapter GUID from the broker's own enumeration. Validated against the live adapter list before execution.

serviceStopBlocklist.dnscache: The DNS Client service does not accept stop requests on Windows 10/11 (SERVICE_ACCEPT_STOP is not set in its controls-accepted mask - verified on this machine: 0x58). Restarting it is not possible through the Service Control Manager. Use flush_dns instead.
